create_RolloutStorage: create a RolloutStorage instance to store rollout data for RL training with observations, actions, and rewards
insert_rollout_data: insert observations, actions, rewards, and masks into the RolloutStorage at the current step index
generate_recurrent_minibatches: generate mini-batched tensors from stored rollout data for recurrent policy training using recurrent_generator
move_storage_to_device: move all RolloutStorage tensors to a specified device like CUDA for GPU-accelerated training
flatten_tensor_helper: flatten a tensor of size (t, n, ...) to (t*n, ...) using the _flatten_helper static method
